<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Snap Falling Fruit](/Feats.aspx?ID=5478) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 74

**Archetype** [Thlipit Contestant](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=224)

**Prerequisites**
[Thlipit Contestant Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5474)

**Trigger**
You or an ally within reach of your lash is the target of a physical ranged attack.

</column>

---

Your lash whips around to intercept projectiles. The target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, you knock it out of the air.
name: Snap Falling Fruit
